ns0:g.ns0:text: Two-film theory couples interfacial equilibrium to flux continuity

ns0:text.ns0:tspan: =1 mol/m³ give equal film fluxes. Interface is at local

ns0:g.ns0:text: equilibrium; bulk phases are not. Separate vertical axes prevent equating pressure numerically with concentration.
